name: VicRoads trade apprentice registration discount
summary: Victorian apprentices who use their own vehicle for their apprenticeship may qualify for free registration.
key: Eligible trade apprentices may qualify for free registration for their work vehicle.
who: Apprentice in an approved training scheme, Victorian resident with a current Victorian licence
Registered operator of a vehicle up to 4.5 tonnes GVM used for the apprenticeship
how: Apply in myVicRoads under 'Apprentice registration discount' at least 5 days before your rego expires.
catches: Learner drivers and vehicles registered in someone else's name are excluded.

evidence.quote: see if you qualify for free registration for your work vehicle
Log in to your myVicRoads account and find the 'Apprentice registration discount' section.
